card.name: Words just before a missing "results"
card.fires_on: Scattered spots in drug-label text where the next word is not "results", such as a comma in an evidence-rating list, "Biological" before DMARDs, or "J" before AK inhibitors. It leans toward the start of drug-class names and rating terms.

modes.label: Evidence rating lists
modes.description: Comma after a rating term such as Likely Effective in a list of effectiveness grades.
modes.example: Effective, Likely Effective<<,>> Possibly Effective, Possibly Ineffective, Likely

modes.label: Start of drug-class names
modes.description: Opening part of a drug class name like biological DMARDs or JAK inhibitors.

modes.label: Not-recommended statements
modes.description: Words like "indicated" or "Not" in statements that a drug is not recommended or indicated.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "results" in several languages and promotes unrelated odd tokens, so it mainly blocks "results" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires at points in drug labels where the word "results" would be an unlikely next word, and it pushes that word down.
